title: 0-setup is a declared, occupied phase: gate-phase-entry.mjs's PRELUDE cell and voice-lint.mjs's NON_VOICE_PHASES entry, with a stated expiry condition
content:
Landed at #53, merged to main as 055038e (squash-merge of PR #79; source commits c6a02f1 test, b580c00 fix, 5a79b7e cross-lane re-baseline, 333ef1f comments-only). WHAT CHANGED. commands/pipeline.md writes `"current_phase": "0-setup"` at its Phase 0, step 5, but it is the ONE assignment in the whole file written in JSON-key form rather than the `current_phase: "..."` unquoted-key form every other assignment uses. Two Lane-1 test suites (test-voice-lint.sh, test-gate-phase-entry-drift.sh) derived their phase populations with a regex that matched only the unquoted-key form, so both suites' own 'every phase we found is accounted for' anti-vacuity control was blind to 0-setup by construction -- the assertion and its control shared the same narrowed population, so a phase the pattern could not see was invisible to both, not merely unaccounted. 0-setup was declared in NEITHER gate-phase-entry.mjs's partition (PREREQUISITES/UNGUARDED/TERMINAL) NOR voice-lint.mjs's tables (VOICE_MOMENTS/NON_VOICE_PHASES). #53 fixed both the derivation (widened to the writer's own quoting forms, both suites now pin the identical 26-member label SET) and the declaration (this entry).

THE DECLARATIONS, both behaviour-neutral at runtime (decision stays not-applicable/exit 0 either way -- verified by a 25-cell matrix run at both refs, 21/25 cells byte-identical, the 4 that differ being 0-setup's reason STRING only). gate-phase-entry.mjs (`plugins/pipeline/scripts/gate-phase-entry.mjs`, re-derive with `git grep -n 'export const PRELUDE'`): a FIFTH exported partition cell, `PRELUDE = ["0-setup"]`, consulted by decideForDir in a branch placed strictly AFTER the terminal check (`isTerminal`). THIS ORDERING IS LOAD-BEARING and was chosen over widening UNGUARDED specifically because the recommended fifth cell keeps UNGUARDED's existing nine reasons byte-unchanged BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by replay (measured anyway, all nine byte-identical, with a `never`->`NEVER` reword proving the comparison can fire). Placement was proven load-bearing by mutation: moving the PRELUDE branch BEFORE isTerminal makes a 0-setup record that ALSO carries `completed_at` render the setup-step clause instead of the terminal ' is finished.' clause, un-finishing a concluded run -- caught by test-gate-phase-entry.sh's #53-P1 (505/0 -> 504/1 under that mutation). A PREREQUISITES row for 0-setup is explicitly REFUSED (not merely avoided): ENTRY is derived from PREREQUISITES keys and must equal the set of phases pipeline.md names at 'Checkpoint first' sites, and 0-setup is not written at a Checkpoint-first site. voice-lint.mjs (`plugins/pipeline/scripts/voice-lint.mjs`, re-derive with `git grep -n '0-setup' -- plugins/pipeline/scripts/voice-lint.mjs`): 0-setup joins NON_VOICE_PHASES (18 -> 19 members). VOICE_MOMENTS and NON_VOICE_PHASES are now BOTH EXPORTED (previously module-private, see architecture--status-schema-json-consumers.json), and voice-lint.mjs adopts, in the SAME commit as the exports, the `evalEntry` self-run guard gate-phase-entry.mjs already shipped -- WITHOUT WHICH THE EXPORTS ARE UNUSABLE (measured: before the guard, importing the module for its tables self-ran its CLI, so a marker printed before the import appeared and one printed after it never did, rc 0 -- every membership assertion built on the new exports would have read a green nothing). run() itself is UNCHANGED -- still `VOICE_MOMENTS[phase] || errorMoment(phase)`, and NON_VOICE_PHASES is read only by selfTest()'s disjointness loop and by the drift test, never by the runtime lookup path. Neither exported table is frozen; the comment beside them records why: `Object.freeze(new Set([...]))` reports `Object.isFrozen() === true` and then silently ACCEPTS `.add()` (measured: size 1 -> 2), because Array.isArray-style shape checks and Object.freeze both behave differently on a Set than on a plain object or array, and #53's own R6 requires the anti-vacuity shape assertion to be at the CONSUMPTION site instead.

THE JUDGEMENT CLAUSE DISCRIMINATES 0-setup FROM AN UNRECOGNISED PHASE, and this is the property the fix is graded on, not the whole reason string. gate-phase-entry.mjs interpolates the record's own directory and phase into a leading `.pipeline/<dir> at `<phase>`` span, so the FULL reason strings for 0-setup and for an invented phase like 9-invented already differed at HEAD before this fix (different phase name interpolated) -- an assertion over the full string was therefore GREEN AT HEAD WITH THE DEFECT LIVE, which is exactly the shape #53's own root-cause analysis warns against (the assertion and its would-be control sharing a blind spot). The correct assertion strips the record-derived span and compares only the remaining JUDGEMENT CLAUSE: at HEAD (pre-fix) both 0-setup and 9-invented reduced to the IDENTICAL 31-byte clause ', which is not a guarded phase.'; post-fix, 0-setup's clause reads ' is the run's setup step, which precedes every guarded phase.' while 9-invented's clause is UNCHANGED at the 31-byte fail-open sentence. Re-derive the 31-byte literal live rather than trusting this text: `printf '%s' ', which is not a guarded phase.' | wc -c`.

THE MECHANISM AND ITS EXPIRY, stated as an outcome property per the standing decision `decisions/assert-outcome-property-not-mechanism.json` (#63). Mechanism: commands/pipeline.md's Phase 0 step 1 (the dirty-worktree halt, the one owner-facing full-voice decision block in Phase 0) runs BEFORE step 5 writes `current_phase: "0-setup"`, so a turn can never end AT 0-setup during that halt -- there is no committed record for voice-lint to ever see with current_phase=0-setup while an owner-facing decision is pending. EXPIRY, stated GENERALLY rather than as the single possible reversal: the declaration becomes WRONG the moment ANY full-voice owner-facing decision block comes to sit between the step that writes current_phase=0-setup and the next Checkpoint-first write. Measured at #53's merge: pipeline.md has exactly one full-voice decision block in Phase 0 (the dirty-worktree halt), the 0-setup write follows it, and the next Checkpoint-first site follows that with zero full-voice/decision-block mentions between them. TRACKED AT ISSUE #80 (HANDOFF A in #53's spec, filed as its own issue because it is a genuine uncovered owner-facing decision moment that #53 does NOT fix -- the dirty-worktree halt itself is structurally unreachable by voice-lint today, for the same before-the-write-exists reason that lets 0-setup be declared non-voice safely). Anyone revisiting #80 by REORDERING pipeline.md's Phase 0 steps must revisit BOTH declarations in this entry, not just voice-lint's -- gate-phase-entry.mjs's PRELUDE cell rests on the identical mechanism.

'0-setup' IS A REAL, OCCUPIED PHASE -- do not cite a zero occupancy count against that fact. A phase-occupancy CENSUS over committed .pipeline/*/status.json current_phase values reads zero for 0-setup, but that measures DURABILITY, not reachability: current_phase=0-setup is overwritten by the very next checkpoint write before anything commits, so the census is structurally blind to it, exactly as it is blind to the five `-complete` pass-through literals documented in architecture--phase-entry-tier-abstention.json. The DECISIVE datum is a committed status.json BLOB carrying `0-setup` as an events[] EXIT MARKER (pipeline.md defines events[] entries as exit markers): blob e4ad3d61ad3388f9a0fc08a611de1b2ab157b2b7, live at HEAD as `.pipeline/exp-script-test-coverage/status.json`, whose events[0] is `{"phase": "0-setup", "note": "clone at 67351ff, tree clean, origin/main fetched"}` -- a real run occupying and CLOSING Phase 0 under this exact name. Re-derive, never re-count: `git rev-list --all | while read c; do git ls-tree -r "$c" | awk '$4 ~ /^\.pipeline\/[^\/]+\/status\.json$/ {print $3}'; done | sort -u | while read b; do git cat-file -p "$b" | grep -n '0-setup'; done` and read the events[] hits, not the current_phase hits.
